reviewCommentsList.author: bthomee
reviewCommentsList.body: Can you please keep this list sorted alphabetically?

reviewCommentsList.author: bthomee
reviewCommentsList.body: You removed the `all - fillOrKill - permDEX` test, but that's still a valid test. The `fillOrKill` belongs to a different amendment.

reviewCommentsList.author: a1q123456
reviewCommentsList.body:
`all - fillOrKill - permDEX` is still here at line 5305. I just rearranged the tests so that they look clearer.
The previous implementation sets up some test feature presets and then each test suite selects a preset by an index. This approach is confusing because it's not very clear what features a suite is trying to test and removing a preset from the list will mess up the order and lots of tests will fail.

reviewCommentsList.author: dangell7
reviewCommentsList.body: I haven't been paying full attention but are we leaving the "If XYZ Amendment is enabled" comments? Just curious.

reviewCommentsList.author: bthomee
reviewCommentsList.body: Sometimes it's a judgment call - some comments provide historic context on how it used to be without it - but here you're right that this first line provides no longer any value.
